newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble decline limited by central bank.
newsitem.headline: Rouble decline limited by central bank.

text.p: The rouble, in plentiful supply as funds flowed in from the government bond market, eased on Wednesday but dealers the central bank had limited its decline with its intervention rates.
roubles/dollar Dec 4 midday Dec 4 early Dec 3 close
In practice banks rarely trade with each other at rates outside the central bank's daily intervention range, which it uses for trading with designated major banks.

"The central bank as usual showed the market it would not allow the dollar to rise quickly. It is not that there are many roubles, they are just sufficient for everyone," ABN-Amro Bank chief dealer Dmitry Piskulov said.
He said non-resident T-bill market participants seemed to be the main source of rouble supply for the rouble/dollar and rouble credit markets.
"The central bank is controlling the market as usual, the situation is calm," United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said.
He said central bank controls would shield the market from the impact of new taxes on cash hard currency purchases and government bond operations.

The State Duma lower house of parliament removed the exemption of operations with government securities from a 15 percent tax on earnings from securities on Wednesday. It also voted to impose a tax on cash purchases of hard currency.
